mentions.name: Semantic Music Visualizer
mentions.description: This app is a semantic music visualizer that captures elements of music in real time — not just tracks but true musical elements — and pairs them with time-stable frame generation for display, aiming to outshine existing visualizers that are essentially demos atop a graphical equalizer.
mentions.problem: Existing music visualizers are basically demos atop a graphical equalizer, lacking true semantic capture of musical elements.
mentions.source_excerpt: A semantic music visualizer :) real-time capture of elements of music —- not tracks but true elements —- paired with time-stable frame generation for display. It likely won’t be as good as a real VJ, but I want to outshine all the visualizers which are basically a demo atop a grapheq.
